verdict.rationale: GitBook's pricing page lists built-in "AI search" for published sites, and its docs cover content search. A community user calls search the platform's best feature, "fast & accurate," though that comment is old and about the earlier product. None of the evidence documents typo tolerance or how relevance ranking works, so only the core of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented typo tolerance, documented relevance ranking behavior, in-depth reader-facing search docs, recent independent corroboration of speed and quality.
